envelope.description: Add native binding and effective-isolation qualification

body.title: Add native binding and effective-isolation qualification
body.summary: Extend shared provider options additively with the approved trusted investigation binding and common qualification records; preserve the existing no-binding review path.
acceptanceChecks: Qualification checks effective isolated tool/config catalogue, adapter/binary/profile identity, cancellation and scoped progress support rather than trusting a boolean or read-only sandbox.
Inherited user/project MCP, plugins/hooks, executable repo instructions and broad tools cannot enter a qualified session; OAuth is not copied or replaced.
Unsupported/unproven adapter versions refuse before a provider call; deterministic fake-CLI evidence is labelled and does not certify an installed binary.

tests.name: Effective native isolation qualification rejects inherited tools and unproven binaries
